extensions.name: Nimora
extensions.description: Live and upcoming sports, movie and TV catalogs, plus anime streams, running as a JavaScript bundle in the sandboxed QuickJS runtime.
extensions.author: nimbusfvck
releaseNotes: Added the current Sokuja storage host used by anime mirrors.
Added Sokuja anime mirrors as the Nova stream provider.
Added a Top Anime shelf to the Home catalog using Crunchyroll availability.
Limited Popular Today to paid streaming subscriptions from TMDB.
Added a Popular Today shelf with streaming titles from TMDB.
Added similar movie and series recommendations to detail metadata.
Added YouTube preview thumbnails to Shegu trailer metadata when TMDB provides one.
Added optional Shegu preview streams for autoplay in the detail header.
Added official TMDB trailers to movie and series detail metadata.
Excluded Baseball events from the sports catalog and featured feed.
Prioritized fixtures involving the configured top football clubs while preserving FotMob's order for the rest of the schedule.
Added TMDB title artwork to featured movie and series items, with text fallback when no logo is available.
Validate Cricfy playback manifests before handing them to the native player, filtering upstream 4xx/5xx and invalid HLS/DASH responses.
Added the exact Cricfy playback hosts required by the manifest preflight guard.
Added richer movie and series details, including release, language, status, and availability facts.
Renamed content certification facts for clarity.
